Tracklist: Make Them Suffer – BLACK SHEEP; Amira Elfeky – Tired; BLEACH TO DEATH – Ache; Bad Juju – Deceiver; Rev3rent – Eyes Wide Shut; Silent Planet – fangs!! [Ft. Jacob Charlton]; Justice For The Damned – Torn In Two; Car Underwater – Waiting (For The Rope To Slip); Desire – Desire; Thy Art Is Murder – Squeeze; Thy Art Is Murder – Reign Of Darkness; Spiritbox – Mourning; VOLATILE WAYS – Not For Your Eyes; thrown – don't be fooled; nightlight – SHUT//UP; Come…
card.title: CORE, 17 Nov

items.note:
I'm a longtime fan of heavy music and still love to dip in occasionally (when I'm not distracted by electronic stuff), so it's a lot of fun to jump into this. 

The standard of the triple j specialist shows is really high! It's the type of radio curation that I used to take for granted growing up.
